all-fields.map:
function(doc) {
    if(doc.data_type === 'log_entry') {
      emit(doc.timestamp, {
        _id: doc._id,
        _rev: doc._rev,
        data_type: doc.data_type,
        timestamp: doc.timestamp,
        level: doc.level,
        context: doc.context,
        message: doc.message,
        fileName: doc.fileName,
        lineNumber: doc.lineNumber,
        columnNumber: doc.columnNumber,
        functionName: doc.functionName,
        stackTrace: doc.stackTrace,
        errorType: doc.errorType,
        is_offline: doc.is_offline,
        process_offline_cases: doc.process_offline_cases,
        offline_session_id: doc.offline_session_id,
        user_name: doc.user_name,
        date_created: doc.date_created
      });
    }
}
